title: Choosing brass: tuba, bass fiddle and the start of his instruments
summary: He tried trumpet and trombone before the tuba, and a schoolmate's bass fiddle introduced him to the bass within months.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: But I fell in love with the brass instruments. First I tried the trumpet, the trombone, and then the tuba. I just

had to hear that sound. So down the road in a place called White Hill, one of the guys in school whose name was Dwight Boone, had an old bass fiddle, so he brought this bass fiddle to school. That was my introduction to the bass fiddle, which was very close to the tuba -- just a matter of months apart. So I always say I started both at the same time, although the tuba actually came first.
And you were how old when you started with the tuba?
Oh, immediately on going to that school you started with the tuba.
